messages:
sam (People Ops): Quick midcycle pulse: two small updates to the review workflow to help with timezone load and late edits. Please skim.

sam (People Ops): New dates: review forms due SUN 11:59pm PT. Calibration panels next Wed/Thu. If you need an extension (travel, LOA), request by Fri EOD.

tara (People Ops): Process tweak 1: rolling unlock window. If a manager requests an edit after deadline, we'll auto-grant a 2-hour unlock for urgent fixes (must include reason in the unlock request).

ishaan (Eng Manager): Will the 2-hour unlock be tracked? We had accidental reopen abuse last cycle.

tara (People Ops): Yes, unlocks are logged and we'll follow up if we see repeated patterns. Use sparingly :slightly_smiling_face:.

sam (People Ops): Process tweak 2: timezone-aware slot allocation. We9re reserving morning slots for APAC-heavy teams and afternoon for AMER/EU to reduce overnight work.

maria (Eng Manager): How do we signal timezone needs? We have cross-region reports.

sam (People Ops): Put your timezone in the signup sheet next to your name and tag any reports with strict timezone constraints. Link: https://docs.google.com/sheets/review-times

zoe (IC): Quick Q: if manager marks "share draft" will IC see it before calibration? Some of us like earlier context.

tara (People Ops): "Share draft" lets ICs see manager notes immediately. Reminder: calibration can change outcomes; managers should avoid definitive language if sharing early.

ishaan (Eng Manager): Any guidance for mid-cycle hires/contractors for evidence expectations?

sam (People Ops): For hires <8 weeks mark "early-data" and give 1-2 bullets. For 8-16 weeks include 2-3 bullets. For <4 weeks mark "insufficient-data" and request extension if needed.

maria (Eng Manager): Can we batch obvious meets-expectations cases to speed panels?

sam (People Ops): Yes  tag rows "batch-quick" in the sheet and include one example doc. Calibrators will allocate 10m slots for batches.

zoe (IC): Is there a recommended format for evidence bullets? Short + metric?

tara (People Ops): Keep bullets concise (1 line) with an outcome/impact when possible. Example: "Reduced tail latency 22% by async queue change".

ishaan (Eng Manager): CSV import headers? Last time a mismatch caused fail.

sam (People Ops): Import expects exactly: employee_email,manager_summary,share_with_ic (lowercase). Use the validator link in #review-ops before upload.

reviews-bot: Reminder scheduled: Review forms due in ~72 hours. Link: https://app.redwood/reviews

maria (Eng Manager): Thanks team. We'll add timezone notes and tag batchable rows.

zoe (IC): Appreciate the unlock window and timezone change.

sam (People Ops): Thanks all  we'll post a 1-page cheat-sheet and the unlock form link in #review-ops later today. Ping @tara or me if stuck. :white_check_mark:
